description: jet-filtration-binding-extensive proves extensivity GIVEN a_D^(n) >= 0 and w_n >= 0. Measured exactly: the binomial-basis body-order coefficients alternate, mu_5 = -55.779 and mu_7 = -373.243, with the sign pattern (+,+,+,-,+,-) identical across all 27 mirror conventions. w_n = M_n(A)*Vol_n(K) is a count times a volume, so w_n >= 0 is STRUCTURAL and cannot be the failing half; the alternation is carried by a_D alone. CONDITIONAL on identifying mu_n with a_D^(n)*w_n, which the corpus does not state and this probe does not establish: the hypothesis is false at n=5,7 and the proposition is vacuous for the physical case. Scope-(a).
